title: Proper-unit maps commute with compact-support adic-to-condensed realization
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite inside $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and put $R=\mathcal O_E$, $t=\varpi_E$, $A_n=R/t^n$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $f=a_X$, and let $h:X\to X$ be a proper $k$-endomorphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], with the specified refinement comparisons to each chosen-compactification functor. Let $M\in D^b_c(X,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and assume every derived reduction $M_n=M\otimes_R^LA_n$ has finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $M'=Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}M$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], with its canonical reduction identifications $M'_n\simeq Lh_n^*M_n$.

Write $P_{R}$ and $P_n$ for the integral and finite compact-support functors for $f$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. At finite level form
$$d_{h,n}:P_nM_n\xrightarrow{P_n\eta_{h,n}}P_nRh_{*,n}Lh_n^*M_n\xrightarrow{Rh_{*,n}\simeq Rh_{!,n},\,\mathrm{comp},\,fh=f}P_nM'_n,$$
using the specified finite pullback/direct-image adjunction and proper/compact-support composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, prop-functor-package]. These maps are evaluations of a canonical morphism $d_{h,\bullet}:\mathcal T_f(M)\to\mathcal T_f(M')$ in the derived category of strict coefficient-restricted towers of [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor]. The assertion includes the quotient transitions and the simultaneous unit/composition construction, rather than inferring a tower morphism from its individual evaluations. Set $D_{h,M}=R\lim d_{h,\bullet}:P_RM\to P_RM'$ using those whole towers [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit].

For $T=X,s$ put $\mathcal R_T(N)=\Omega_T^c\otimes^L_{E_T^c}J_T(N[1/t])$, where $J_T$ is [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization] and $E_T^c\to\Omega_T^c$ is [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]. Use the canonical pullback comparison $c_{h,M}:\mathcal R_X(M')\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*_{\mathrm{cond}}\mathcal R_X(M)$, induced by the pullback comparisons for $J$ and coefficient extension. Let $P_\Omega$ be the actual module-object compact-support functor [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek]. Assume $C_N=\operatorname{Fib}_s(P_RN)[1/t]\in D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ for $N=M,M'$ [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. Let
$$b_N:P_\Omega\mathcal R_X(N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho_{E,s}(C_N)$$
be the natural comparison obtained from the inverse of the ordered integral-to-condensed compact-support comparison of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization], followed by point realization into the finite-matrix functor $\rho_{E,s}$ of [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace]. In particular the point comparison takes each coefficient matrix to the same matrix through $E\to\Omega$. Define $d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,\mathcal R_XM}$ by the condensed proper-unit composite $P_\Omega\eta_h$, proper coincidence $Rh_*\simeq Rh_!$, compact-support composition, and $fh=f$, with the same chosen-compactification normalizations. Then the equality of specified maps is
$$b_{M'}\circ P_\Omega(c_{h,M}^{-1})\circ d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,\mathcal R_XM}
=\rho_{E,s}\bigl(\operatorname{Fib}_s(D_{h,M})[1/t]\bigr)\circ b_M.$$
All the displayed comparisons are natural in $M$, including on morphisms of the whole coefficient systems. No Frobenius endomorphism or Weil structure is assumed.

source.place: Definition 6.7.6, Lemmas 6.7.7 and 6.7.14, Proposition 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15. Agent-formulated proper-unit coherence prerequisite for the canonical comparison of lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization; these references supply the operations and coefficient equivalence, not the asserted equality of specified whole-tower maps.
